Package com.rpglab.game.characters.monsters

Class Dragon

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.rpglab.game.characters.Character
      • com.rpglab.game.characters.Monster
        • com.rpglab.game.characters.monsters.Dragon
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Combatente, Lootable
    public class Dragon
extends Monster
    Represents a Dragon monster in the Dungeon Adventure RPG. Dragons are powerful draconic creatures encountered in the Dark Hallway, serving as formidable mid-game bosses. They possess devastating fire-based attacks and intimidating presence that make them extremely dangerous foes.

    Dragons are equipped with two combat actions:

    • Roar - An intimidating sound attack that damages through fear and sonic force
    • Fire Breath - A devastating fire-breathing attack dealing massive damage

    • Constructor Detail

      • Dragon

        public Dragon​(java.lang.String name,
              int healthPoints,
              int strength,
              int experience,
              Weapon[] loot)
        Constructs a new Dragon monster with the specified attributes. Automatically equips the dragon with Roar and Fire Breath combat actions.
        Parameters:
        name - The dragon's name
        healthPoints - The dragon's initial health points
        strength - The dragon's strength value
        experience - The experience points awarded when this dragon is defeated
        loot - Array of weapons this dragon can drop as loot
